text:
Palladium Price in 1995
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1995, the LBMA palladium price fell 18.3% between 1995-01-31 ($157) and 1995-12-28 ($128). The highest sampled price was $175 in March and the lowest was $128 in December. The mean of these observations was $150. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
